description: Reconstruction uses projected flags without the lazy directive or a diagnostic lean (engine §7.10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution lazy elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | old | c
%rule (leftmost-longest) w (X [+T])
%rule missing (M N)
%rule old ([+U] X)
%rule (leftmost-longest) c (r T)
%rule r (X e)
%rule e ε
